review_description: We got this installed in March.
I applied to Country Energy for approval at the end of September but still have not received a reply. How long do I have to wait?

The cost to the purchaser is far more than implied in so many advertisements.Country Energy was not in a hurry to supply the meter, hence an almost 4 week wait for connection after the panels were installed.
